title: lfk configuration
description: Schema for the lfk config file (config.yaml). All fields are optional; only the values you set override the defaults. See docs/config-reference.md for full descriptions.

appearance.description: Visual settings group (colorscheme, icons, no_color, transparent_background, min_contrast_ratio, dim_overlay). Canonical home for these knobs; the flat keys of the same name are deprecated aliases. When both are set, appearance wins.

colorscheme.description: Deprecated alias for appearance.colorscheme. Built-in color scheme name (e.g. "tokyonight-storm", "dracula", "nord"). Supports dual-mode syntax for auto dark/light switching: "dark:X,light:Y".

log_path.description: Path to the application log file. Defaults to ~/.local/share/lfk/lfk.log.

kubeconfig_dir.description: Directory (or list of directories) recursively scanned for kubeconfig files, in addition to ~/.kube/config and KUBECONFIG. Tilde paths expand against $HOME.

abbreviations.description: Custom search abbreviation overrides/extensions. Maps a short alias to a full resource type name (e.g. "po": "pod").

icons.description: Deprecated alias for appearance.icons. Icon display mode. "auto" detects Nerd Font terminals. Overridable at runtime with the LFK_ICONS env var.

resource_columns.description: Per-resource-type column lists, keyed by Kind name (case-insensitive). Deprecated: prefer "views".

views.description: Per-resource-type column and sort configuration, keyed by GVR ("apps/v1/deployments") or Kind ("deployment", case-insensitive).

dashboard.description: Show the cluster dashboard when entering a context. Set false to go directly to resource types.

custom_actions.description: User-defined actions per resource type, keyed by Kind name (e.g. "Pod").

filter_presets.description: User-defined quick filter presets per resource type, keyed by Kind name (case-insensitive).

terminal.description: How exec/shell commands run: "pty" (embedded in the TUI), "exec" (takes over the terminal), or "mux" (open in a new tmux/zellij window or pane).

scrollback_lines.description: Per-tab capacity of the embedded PTY scrollback ring buffer. Clamped to [100, 100000]. Only meaningful in pty mode.

pinned_groups.description: CRD API groups to pin after built-in categories (e.g. ["karpenter.sh", "monitoring.coreos.com"]).

pinned_types.description: Version-agnostic resource-type pin keys ("group/resource", e.g. "apps/deployments") to move into the top-level Pinned section.

monitoring.description: Per-cluster monitoring endpoint configuration. Keys are context names or the special key "_global".

tips.description: Show a random tip in the status bar on startup.

log_viewer.description: Log viewer settings: tail sizes, ANSI rendering, and the startup-toggle defaults for preview/prefixes/timestamps. Canonical home for these knobs; the flat log_tail_lines, log_tail_lines_short, and log_render_ansi keys are deprecated aliases. Note: log_path is the application's own log file and is NOT a log_viewer setting.

log_tail_lines.description: Deprecated alias for log_viewer.tail_lines. Number of log lines loaded initially via --tail. Scrolling to the top loads older history.

log_tail_lines_short.description: Deprecated alias for log_viewer.tail_lines_short. Number of log lines loaded by the action menu "Tail Logs" entry. Non-positive values are ignored.

log_render_ansi.description: Deprecated alias for log_viewer.render_ansi. Render ANSI SGR sequences (color, bold, underline) emitted by log producers. Set false to strip them. Toggle at runtime with :set ansi / :set noansi.

split_preview.description: Startup default for the split preview pane. Set false to start with the pane hidden.

watch_mode.description: Startup default for live watch/polling. Set false to start with manual refresh.

all_namespaces.description: Startup namespace scope: true shows all namespaces, false scopes to the context's default namespace. The --namespace CLI flag and per-bookmark/session scope override this.

scrolloff.description: Number of lines to keep visible above/below the cursor when scrolling.

confirm_on_exit.description: Show a quit confirmation when pressing ctrl+c on the last tab. Set false to exit immediately.

dim_overlay.description: Deprecated alias for appearance.dim_overlay. Fade the rest of the screen while any overlay is up. Set false for terminals where SGR faint looks awkward.

transparent_background.description: Deprecated alias for appearance.transparent_background. Use the terminal's own background for bars and surfaces. Selection highlights remain opaque.

mouse.description: Capture mouse input for click navigation, scroll, and tab switching. Set false to allow native terminal text selection.

watch_interval.description: Polling interval used in watch mode, as a Go duration string (e.g. "2s", "500ms", "1m"). Clamped to [500ms, 10m].

clusters.description: Per-cluster configuration overrides, keyed by context name.

no_color.description: Deprecated alias for appearance.no_color. Strip foreground/background colors from all styles (monochrome). The NO_COLOR env var takes precedence.

secret_lazy_loading.description: When true, Secret listing fetches metadata only and decoded values load on hover. Faster in clusters with many large Secrets.

informer_cache.description: List strategy: "off" round-trips every list, "auto" promotes a resource type to a shared informer above 1000 items, "always" opens a watch eagerly. Legacy bool form: true -> always, false -> off.

min_contrast_ratio.description: Deprecated alias for appearance.min_contrast_ratio. Normalized readability knob in [0.0, 1.0]. Above zero, foreground colors are nudged in HSL lightness to meet a minimum WCAG contrast ratio. 0.175 is approximately AA, 0.3 is approximately AAA.

read_only.description: Disable all mutating actions globally. Per-context overrides under clusters.<name>.read_only and the --read-only CLI flag take precedence.

show_rare_types.description: Show rarely-used resource types (CSI internals, admission webhooks, leases, runtime classes, the "Advanced" category) from startup, as if the H toggle were pressed.

union_sets.description: Named multi-cluster groups expanded by the --union-set <name> CLI flag. Accepts a list of entries or a map keyed by set name.

theme.description: Custom color theme overrides applied on top of the selected colorscheme. Values are hex colors (e.g. "#7aa2f7") or terminal color names/ANSI codes.

keybindings.description: Custom keybinding overrides. Each value is a key string (e.g. "j", "ctrl+d", "alt+ctrl+y"). Avoid ctrl+i / ctrl+m / ctrl+[ (terminals emit these as tab/enter/esc).

view.description: Ordered columns and an optional default sort column for a resource type.

columns.description: Ordered column specs. Each is a built-in name or a custom "Name:.jsonPath" spec; append flags after "|" (e.g. "|W" for wide-only).

sort_column.description: Default sort column, optionally with direction: "COL", "COL:asc", or "COL:desc".

command.description: Shell command template (supports template variables; see config-reference.md).

key.description: Shortcut key that triggers the action.

description.description: Help text shown in the action menu.

read_only_safe.description: Declare the action does not change cluster state, so it stays available in read-only mode. Defaults to false (treated as mutating).

key.description: Shortcut key in the filter presets overlay.

filterMatch.description: Match criteria, AND-ed together. When invert is true the result is negated.

status.description: Match rows whose Status equals this value.

ready_not.description: Match rows that are NOT Ready.

restarts_gt.description: Match rows whose restart count exceeds this value.

column.description: Column name to match against (used with column_value).

column_value.description: Value the named column must equal.

node_metrics.description: Node metrics source. Defaults to auto-detect.

namespaces.description: Namespaces to search for the monitoring service.

port.description: Port number (default: "9090" for prometheus, "9093" for alertmanager).

read_only.description: Override the global read_only setting for this context.

k8s_client_qps.description: Override the foreground REST client QPS for this context.

k8s_client_burst.description: Override the foreground REST client burst for this context.

enabled.description: Turn the security dashboard on or off.

hide_badges.description: Hide the per-resource SEC severity badge by default. The dashboard still scans; only the inline row badge is suppressed (toggleable at runtime). Settable globally and per-cluster (clusters.<name>.security.hide_badges overrides the global default for that context).

sources.description: Enable/disable individual sources. Keys accept friendly names (heuristic, trivy, kyverno, kubescape, falco, gatekeeper) or internal ids (trivy-operator, policy-report). Omitted sources default to enabled.

ignore_patterns.description: Declarative glob-based ignore rules applied at load. Honored only in the top-level security section.

heuristic.description: Tuning options for the built-in heuristic source. Honored only in the top-level security section.

secret_env_include.description: Extra env-var name globs (* and ?, case-insensitive) the secret_env check flags, on top of the built-in credential keywords. An explicit match overrides a built-in exemption.

secret_env_exclude.description: Env-var name globs (* and ?, case-insensitive) the secret_env check never flags, on top of the built-in exemptions. Wins over secret_env_include.

securityIgnorePattern.description: A finding is ignored when every non-empty field matches it. Fields support glob (* and ?). An all-empty pattern is dropped.

cluster.description: Globs the kube-context name. Empty = any cluster.

source.description: Globs the security source id. Empty = any source.

group.description: Globs the finding group key (CVE id, check label, rule name). Empty = any group.

namespace.description: Globs the resource namespace. Empty or * = any namespace.

comment.description: Free-text note explaining why the rule exists.

rightsizingDefaults.description: Initial strategy and headroom for the right-sizing advisor on its first overlay open of the session.

headroom.description: Headroom multiplier. Must match one of the picker presets.

logViewerConfig.description: Log viewer settings. All fields optional; missing keys fall back to compiled defaults (or a deprecated flat alias).

tail_lines.description: Number of log lines loaded initially via --tail. Scrolling to the top loads older history.

tail_lines_short.description: Number of log lines loaded by the action menu "Tail Logs" entry. Non-positive values are ignored.

render_ansi.description: Render ANSI SGR sequences (color, bold, underline) emitted by log producers. Set false to strip them. Toggle at runtime with :set ansi / :set noansi.

show_preview.description: Startup default for the structured preview side panel (runtime toggle: P). Set false to start with it hidden.

show_prefixes.description: Startup default for the [pod/name/container] line prefixes (runtime toggle: p). Set false to start with prefixes hidden.

show_timestamps.description: Startup default for log line timestamps (runtime toggle: s). Set true to start with timestamps shown.

max_lines.description: Maximum streamed log lines retained per tab; once exceeded, the oldest lines are dropped so a long-running follow does not grow memory without bound. Clamped to [1000, 1000000].

yamlViewerConfig.description: YAML viewer settings. All fields optional; missing keys keep compiled defaults.

wrap.description: Startup default for line wrapping (runtime toggle: z).

diffViewerConfig.description: Diff viewer settings. All fields optional; missing keys keep compiled defaults.

wrap.description: Startup default for line wrapping (runtime toggle: Ctrl+W / >).

line_numbers.description: Startup default for the gutter line numbers (runtime toggle: #).

unified.description: Startup default for the unified (vs side-by-side) layout (runtime toggle: u).

describeViewerConfig.description: Describe viewer settings. All fields optional; missing keys keep compiled defaults.

wrap.description: Startup default for line wrapping (runtime toggle: z).

objectExplorerConfig.description: Object Explorer settings. All fields optional; missing keys keep compiled defaults.

live.description: Startup default for live-refreshing the browsed object as the resource changes under watch mode (runtime toggle: w).

appearanceConfig.description: Visual settings. All fields optional; missing keys fall back to a deprecated flat alias or the compiled default.

colorscheme.description: Built-in color scheme name. Supports dual-mode syntax "dark:X,light:Y".

icons.description: Icon display mode. "auto" detects Nerd Font terminals.

no_color.description: Strip foreground/background colors (monochrome). NO_COLOR env var takes precedence.

transparent_background.description: Use the terminal's own background for bars and surfaces.

min_contrast_ratio.description: Readability knob in [0.0, 1.0]; nudges foreground lightness to a minimum WCAG contrast ratio.

dim_overlay.description: Fade the rest of the screen while any overlay is up.

eventsConfig.description: Events view settings. All fields optional; missing keys keep compiled defaults.

warnings_only.description: Start the events view filtered to Warning events only.

grouping.description: Start with related events grouped by reason.

kubeshark.description: Kubeshark hand-off backend for the Traffic Capture overlay.

namespace.description: Namespace where Service kubeshark-hub lives. Defaults to "kubeshark".

scheduler.description: Runtime knobs for the priority task scheduler. All fields optional; missing keys fall back to compiled defaults.

timeouts_by_kind.description: Per-kind timeout overrides. Values are Go duration strings.

aging_threshold.description: Bounds priority starvation: a background task runs after at most this many higher-priority dispatches. 0 disables aging.

name.description: Identifier used by --union-set to reference this entry.

contexts.description: Cluster entries to merge in this union view.

namespace.description: Namespace lfk opens in when this set is selected. --namespace overrides it.

unionSetContext.description: One cluster within a union set. A bare string is the context name; an object adds an optional per-set color and namespace.

color.description: Per-set row tile color. Invalid values are dropped (untinted).
